lines:
Fixed all five reported subagent/external-agent defects.

Fast child reads (slow tab): added partial expression index semantic_events_subagent_child and LocalHistoryStore::child_event_window; subagent_feed_page now returns one child's own newest page directly (LIMIT 129 probe for has_more) instead of walking parent history page-by-page; useSubagentFeed stops on an empty/exhausted page, so a child with no activity settles in one read.

Live external activity: added SubagentProgressV1/Kind/Sink plus a defaulted run_observed to the one-shot backend seam; Codex app-server and Claude Code forward bounded, secret-free progress (commentary text, tool kind, reasoning, completion). external.rs commits each note as a child-tagged model.progress fact on a detached child evidence stream (max 200 notes, one omission note), rendered by the normal timeline.

Readable input: SubagentConversation renders the delegated task and assigned context as Markdown in bounded collapsible briefs with a single-line header title.

Composer gating: hasOpenSemanticSpan ignores child-owned (subagentChildId) spans, so a running background child no longer forces the parent Chat into a live turn; Send stays available and Stop no longer latches on a child's open span.

Layout: tabs no longer shrink (so the Chat tab cannot be overlapped by the next tab), the strip is a labelled horizontally scrolling stack, and the Chat view header paints above it.

Verification: cargo check --tests (desktop) clean; cargo test -p aworkit-capability-host --lib external_agent 46 passed (incl. new Codex progress forwarding and bounded-note tests); cargo test desktop lib a_child_page passed with the updated child-scope assertions; vitest activityProjection/useSubagentFeed/SubagentTabs/subagentWorkspace 35 passed. Docs updated in docs/subagent-tool-inheritance.md.

Five reported defects in the delegated-subagent surface:

1. Layout: the Chat Workspace tab strip partly covers/overlaps the Chat view header; the parent Chat tab is partly covered by the first child tab.
2. Readability: the delegated task and assigned context are rendered as raw preformatted text (especially for external agents), so the tab opens on an unreadable wall of text.
3. Performance: opening a subagent tab is far slower than loading the main Chat. The child feed pages back through raw history one bounded page per IPC until a child-tagged event appears; a child with no tagged events scans the entire Run.
4. External agents (Codex) show no activity at all: the one-shot external backend deliberately discards product notifications, so the child tab shows nothing until the delegation finishes.
5. Composer gating: while a background delegated child is still running, the parent Chat is treated as a live turn (Stop shown, send blocked), so the user cannot reply until Stop, which then cancels the child.

Fix completely: bounded child-scoped history read via a JSON-expression index and one SQL query; add a progress sink to the external-agent one-shot seam and forward bounded, secret-free product progress; publish child-tagged activity the child tab renders; make the parent liveness signal ignore child-owned spans; format task/context as Markdown; and repair the tab/header layout.

data.title: Fix subagent and external-agent tabs: overlap, readable input, fast loading, live Codex activity, composer gating
